title: Fields of the night queue that the overnight ticket plugin reads
description: The queue planning step writes .baltor/night/queue.json once before the night. The plugin reads record_type, the ordered items and the held list, ignores other fields and never writes the queue. A result record stores the SHA-256 of these exact bytes.

title.description: Display text only. The planning step may write an empty title; the plugin shows the first 200 characters.

position.description: When present it equals the item's place in the list, counting from 1.
